sources.entry: Orca - An open-source IDE for running parallel AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, OpenCode), each in its own isolated git worktree. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/stablyai/orca) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Orca
summary.one_liner: Orca is an open-source Agent Development Environment (ADE) that runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor CLI and other coding agents in parallel, each in an isolated git worktree.
keywords: run multiple coding agents at once
use_cases: Running several coding agents on the same repo without conflicts
Monitoring agent status and usage from a phone
Chatting with one agent across multiple repos in a parent folder
Running coding agents on a remote machine or VPS
Splitting a feature into parallel tasks in isolated worktrees
summary.what_it_does: Orca splits tasks into isolated workspaces backed by git worktrees so multiple agents can work side by side without interfering. It works with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Grok, Gemini, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and many other listed agent CLIs, plus any other CLI agent, using the subscriptions the user already has. It bundles worktrees, terminals, a browser and CLI in one app, with review and remote features. A companion app for iOS and Android lets users watch live agent status, check usage, switch accounts and keep terminal work going away from the desk.
notable: Isolated git worktrees per agent task
Works with many CLI agents including Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and Cursor
Mobile companion app for monitoring and switching accounts
Chat across multiple repos in a parent folder
caveats: Page does not state the license name; described as open source and free
Testimonials and marketing claims (such as 'dramatically faster') are not independently verified
Mobile companion requires pairing with the desktop app
